source_title: Computacenter plc Annual Report and Accounts 2019
availability_evidence: https://investors.computacenter.com/news-releases/news-release-details/computacenter-2019-annual-report-notice-2020-agm — issuer states the report was published on 9 April 2020; direct official PDF remained inspectable page by page through the public web archive although repeated direct byte retrieval timed out
observation: FusionStorm had two challenging Professional Services projects, lower margins and utilisation pressure, and an investment backlog; action plans restored performance above the acquisition baseline. Group Services margin increased 248bps, adjusted profit before tax increased 23.8%, operating cash inflow rose to £200.2m and adjusted net funds increased from £66.2m to £137.1m.
review_note: Repeated but contained acquired-business pressure was offset by improving margins, strong profit growth, stronger operating cash flow and sharply higher adjusted net funds.

source_title: Computacenter plc Annual Report and Accounts 2023
availability_evidence: https://investors.computacenter.com/news-releases/news-release-details/computacenter-2023-annual-financial-report-notice-2024-agm — issuer states the report was published on 11 April 2024; direct official PDF remained inspectable page by page through the public web archive although repeated direct byte retrieval timed out
observation: Inflation, incremental strategic investment and weaker UK performance constrained profit growth. Adjusted operating profit as a percentage of gross profit fell 240bps to 26.0%, while adjusted operating profit still rose 0.9%. Revenue rose 7.0%, gross profit 10.2%, operating cash flow 69.6% and adjusted net funds 87.9% to £459.0m.
review_note: Specific inflation, investment and UK pressure accompanied a greater-than-200bps productivity-margin decline. Strong revenue and gross-profit growth, sharply higher cash flow and record adjusted net funds provided strong quantified contrary evidence.
